howIncompleteInputWasHandled: STRICT: every card had exactly one valid verdict.
readingTheNumbers: Performance on a deliberately difficult, stratified holdout. This is not a probability sample and is not an estimate or formal lower bound on national precision. The Wilson bound applies to this holdout's reviewed cases, not to a nationally weighted population.

conditions.name: zeroConfirmedGradeSeparatedFalsePositives
conditions.why: an AT_GRADE crossing the reviewer calls grade separated is a node created where one road passes over another: it invents a turn onto a motorway, which is the confident wrong answer the never-node rule existed to prevent

conditions.name: zeroConfirmedNotAJunctionFalsePositives
conditions.why: an AT_GRADE crossing the reviewer calls not-a-junction is usually one road recorded twice; noding it joins a road to itself and fabricates a cycle, a shortcut or a turn that is not on the ground

conditions.name: lowerBound95OnAtGradePrecision
conditions.why: AT_GRADE is the only disposition that changes the canonical graph, so its precision is the number that governs whether the classifier may rebuild it

conditions.name: unreviewableCountedAsFailures
conditions.requirement: the bound above must be computed with unreviewable cards counted as failures
conditions.why: a card the reviewer could not read is not evidence that the classifier was right; excluding them measures precision on the subset that was easiest to see, which is the subset least likely to hold the errors. Recorded as met because it describes HOW the bound above was computed - it is a property of the method, not of the result

promotionGate.detail: n=350: 314 confirmed, 32 contradicted, 4 unreviewable. Lower 95% bound 86.1% counting unreviewable as failures, 87.2% excluding them. NOT MET: zeroConfirmedNotAJunctionFalsePositives, lowerBound95OnAtGradePrecision.
